scope.criterion: A fresh process owner survives inherited shutdown quiescence and pre-OPEN heartbeat ticks; a new Stop generation still closes, cancels and joins before runtime drain/quiescence.

requirement_dispositions.requirement: Historical quiescence must not permanently close the fresh model owner
requirement_dispositions.evidence: __main__.py:119-131 constructs the fresh owner, awaits initial real quiesce using runtime.drain, and only then installs the irreversible close hook. Lines 169-175 skip only the already-handled startup generation when a task owner exists. Original two-case reproducer and six added lifecycle cases pass.

requirement_dispositions.requirement: No newly introduced pre-READY model admission
requirement_dispositions.evidence: Initial quiesce now completes before LocalControl construction/entry. The strict drain hook is installed before __aenter__ can serve. LocalControl.model_test starts as None; its assignment after __aenter__ and SUPERVISOR_READY have no intervening await. Supervisor startup still never calls open. Existing DB owner/generation/shutdown/fence checks are unchanged. This is not a newly executed live admission proof.

requirement_dispositions.requirement: New OPEN/Stop generations retain strict drain and cannot be lost
requirement_dispositions.evidence: InstanceService.open:439 and shutdown:475-476 monotonically increment generation. A generation different from startup always follows the original quiesce path. An old owned_status snapshot can skip one tick, but cannot write a false receipt or skip the next changed generation. Quiesce re-reads under its own DB locks and closes/cancels/joins before runtime drain and receipt update. The added stop cases exercise real open/shutdown/quiesce methods and real close_model_test with synthetic persistence and transport.

requirement_dispositions.requirement: Finalizer and P0/non-model behavior remain intact
requirement_dispositions.evidence: Finalizer close_model_test -> runtime.drain -> runtime.close -> release/dispose remains byte-unchanged. Startup-failure and early-close cases pass. When task_owner is None, the heartbeat branch always calls quiesce as before; no new generation read is required for P0. Existing source opt-in, runtime-loss and case-owner tests pass.

requirement_dispositions.requirement: Tests do not hide the irreversible close latch or claim real DB/model success
requirement_dispositions.evidence: New regression keeps supervisor.run, InstanceService.open/shutdown/quiesce and NativeTaskOwner close real. Persistence/lease validation, Stop-fence I/O, LocalControl transport and runtime are doubles; the active task is synthetic. The operation test removes direct latch reset and explicitly constructs a different owner/epoch, checks old-owner refusal and retained UNKNOWN without additional sends. Its mocked service is not proof of fresh DB authority.
